---
name: to-spec
description: Turn user requirements and decisions into a structured songbook product and technical specification.
---

Read the existing `docs/spec.md` and the relevant domain guidance in `docs/agents/`. Convert the user's requirements into a concise, testable specification aligned with the existing Next.js, json-server, TypeScript, and Tailwind architecture. Preserve established decisions, call out conflicts, define data/API contracts, and include measurable acceptance criteria. Update `docs/spec.md` only when the user asks to write the specification; otherwise present the proposed changes first.
